{{Quote|General Garza expressed no concern as I'm sure she's familiar with the temporary clearance authorized by Security Code MR-7-C.|Elara Dorne|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Security Code MR-7-C''' was a regulation in the [[Republic Army]] that allowed certain [[Officer/Legends|officers]] to acquire temporary authorization to monitor the [[armor-cam]]s of various personnel. Under Code MR-7-C, [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Elara Dorne]] was authorized to monitor the armor-cams of [[Havoc Squad]] during the unit's mission on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].
